articleTitle: An Anomaly Detection Framework Based on Autoencoder and Nearest Neighbor
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In recent years, anomaly detection has become a focal point of data mining, and numerous efforts have been made to conduct extensive researches on the theories and techniques for detecting abnormal data points. Although the amount of anomaly data is relatively small, they can potentially bring huge losses to social economy, public resources and individual properties. Thus, we propose an unsupervised anomaly detection framework named AEKNN, which aims to incorporate the advantages of automatically learnt representation by deep neural network to boost anomaly detection performance. The framework combines the training of an autoencoder and a k-th nearest neighbor based outlier detection method. We further validate the performance of our proposed model with an extensive experimental study on three UCI datasets. The parameter sensitivity results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can scale well with respect to both dataset size, data feature dimensionality and anomaly class proportion.

articleTitle: ETCF: An Ensemble Model for CTR Prediction
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Online advertising has attracted lots of attention in both academic and industrial domains. Among many realworld advertising systems, click through rate (CTR) prediction plays a central role. With a large volume of user history log and given its various features, it is quite a challenge to fully extract the meaningful information inside that amount of data. What's more, for many machine learning models, in order to achieve the best performance of the CTR prediction, a lot of hyper-parameters need to be tuned, which often costs plenty of time. In this paper, we propose an ensemble model named ETCF, which cascades GBDT with gcForest to tackle the practical problems of CTR prediction and do not need much hyper-parameter tuning work to realize its best performance. Experimental results validate the effective prediction power of ETCF against classical baseline models, and the superiority of GBDT transformed features.

articleTitle: A Nearest Neighbor Based Personal Rank Algorithm for Collaborator Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Nowadays, more and more scholars find their own research collaborators through social platforms for scientific research. Due to the information overload problem, how to recommend collaborators accurately has become an important issue. In addition, with the development of academic research, interdisciplinary studies are more and more common. Previous topic modeling methods and some other social friend recommendation algorithms are not suitable for the recommendation of scientific research collaborators. Inspired by random walk with restart (RWR) and PageRank approach, this paper provides a nearest neighbor based random walk algorithm (NNRW) to recommend collaborators. Compared to the fixed probability of walking in traditional random walk algorithm, NNRW achieves better performance because it incorporates the social network characteristics and the probability of walking depends on the historical cooperation of the target user.

articleTitle: Gender Difference on Destination Image and Travel Options: An Exploratory Text-Mining Study
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Destination image has gained increasingly attention of tourism researchers. However, little attention has been devoted to study the difference in perception of destination image among different demographic groups using the big data analytics in general, the text mining approach in particular. Therefore, in this paper, we develop a method based on Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) to extract cognitive destination image from travel blogs. Furthermore, we explore the differences in cognitive image and travel options among different gender groups. Through experiments, we extract 26 topics by LDA and find that the female has significantly preferences to natural landscape and rural scenery than the male. Meanwhile, the male prefers historical sites than the female. In terms of the travel options, we find the female usually travel with travel agency, while the male travel by self-drive. Our study contributes to the tourism planning, tourism positioning and marketing for different target groups.

articleTitle: Case Analysis on Value Creation and Sustainable Development Path of Supply Chain Integrators
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The supply chain integrators reduce costs of supply chain and improve the operation efficiency of enterprises, and they exert important influence to keep good performance of supply chain. There are many researches focusing on the economic role of integrators. However, economic function is not enough for many firms, they have to consider environmental impacts and social responsibilities in the current age. Through case analysis, this research contributes to literature on how or through what mechanisms integrators can take advantage of their resources to build sustainable supply chain in three dimensions including economic, environmental, and social.

articleTitle: Multi-Channel Recycling Decisions of Electric Vehicle Battery Based on SD-Dynamic Game Model
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Recycling of spent electric vehicle (EV) batteries has caused worldwide attention in practice and in literature. This study addresses the problem of spent EV battery collection through multi-channel i.e. automobile manufacturer, 4S shop, and third-party recycler. Specifically, considering many realistic fluctuating factors, we innovatively combine game theory and system dynamics (SD) to establish the SD-dynamic game model. Results show that the model is fully capable of describing the reality, the game equilibrium, and the evolution of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Assessment of Railway Freight Station Based on Nonlinear Combination of Ahp-Entropy
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The freight transportation stations in railway transportation often have problems in managing people, goods, facilities and equipment, and environmental warnings. Risk assessment of railway freight stations is to ensure the safe and reliable operation of freight transport. The results of risk assessment can be used as the basis for the selection of stations. After sorting the risk values of the indicators, they can be controlled for high risk factors. To solve this problem, this paper uses a nonlinear combined weighting method based on AHP and entropy-weighted method, combines with the collected data to obtain the station comprehensive risk value, and returns to determine the risk of each indicator, and obtains the risk ranking of the risk factors of the station to take response. Measures provide data support. Taking the A station in North China as an example, the station's 2016 target data was collected and simulated to obtain the station's risk level and potential risk factors. The conclusion shows that the stations perform well in process management, and there are security risks in the information system and other aspects. The results of the model are in good agreement with the actual conditions, which shows the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Wechat Mini Program Acceptance Based on UTA UT Model Take the Pearl River Delta as an Example
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Users' acceptance is important to evaluate the success of an application tool. There is no exception to the Wechat Mini Program. Based on the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT), we construct a model with more explanative variables to investigate the affecting factors of users' acceptance towards Wechat Mini Program. Using samples of college students in Pearl River Delta, we collected data by conducting an online questionnaire survey and applied them to test our model through a Structural Equation Modeling (SEM). The empirical results indicate that the five variables: Endeavor Expectation, Performance Expectation, Community Impact, Perceived Risk and Perceived Interference, affect users' Behavior Intention. Furthermore, Behavior Intention and Convenience Level jointly influence Usage Behavior of Wechat Mini Program. Finally, according to these results, our study proposes some suggestions on how to improve the users' acceptance towards Wechat Mini Program.

articleTitle: Influence of Cognitive Resource Limitation on Consumer Purchasing Decision: An Event-Related Potentials Perspective
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This research aims to study the neural influence of conflict between product appearance and performance on consumer decision when consumers' cognitive resources are limited. In order to manipulate the cognitive resources, 20 subjects were asked to memorize a 20-digit number in 20s. Then, stimuli of products with appearance and performance information were displayed randomly. Subjects need to decide whether to buy, while the Electroencephalogram (EEG) was recorded. The stimuli were divided into four conditions based on the consistency of appearance and performance (condition 1: more attractive and superior performance; condition 2: more attractive and inferior performance; condition 3: less attractive and superior performance; condition 4: less attractive and inferior performance). Results showed that conditions 1 and 2 had higher purchase rate than other two conditions, but the difference between conditions 1 and 2 was not significant. Although both conditions 2 and 3 have conflicting information, condition 3 evoked the highest amplitude of conflict-related N270 than other conditions in the prefrontal regions. Aesthetics-related P2 were also elicited among posterior-parietal regions in all configurations, but the P2 amplitude triggered by condition 2 was significantly larger than other conditions. The findings indicated that consumers need to call more cognitive resources to integrate several pieces of product information when product appearance conflicts with its performance. When their cognitive resources were limited, they tended to use automatic, affective processes over thoughtful, cognitive ones which leaded to a high purchase rate, a smaller N270 and a larger P2 for the more attractive but inferior performance products. Hence, P2 and N270 may be useful neural endogenous indicators to reflect the process of handling conflicts in consumer decision.

articleTitle: Optimization of Resource-Constrained Multi-Project Scheduling Problem Based on the Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In order to solve the resource-constrained multi-project scheduling problem(RCMPSP),a mathematical optimization model is proposed, and the genetic algorithm is designed for this model.This algorithm uses the coding method based on priority of activities, combined with the storage adjacency matrix,which can effectively eliminate the activity scheduling violation. Besides,this paper applies this model to the medical resource scheduling. The parameter analysis indicates that the decision-makers can adjust the feasibility and optimization of the solution by regulating the risk coefficient of the model, which can help the decision-makers to make the decision according to the risk preference.

articleTitle: Parking Space Allocation with Uncertain Demand and Supply Consideration
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the lack of parking lots becoming more and more serious, shared parking appears in our daily life. This paper studies the strategy of the capacity allocation between reservation customers and the walk-in customers with uncertain demand and supply consideration in the shared parking platform. The decision principle of the booking limit has been proposed. We also have performed computational experiments to verify the relationship between booking limit and the expected revenue, and have investigated the sensitivity of the optimal booking limit.

articleTitle: Study on the Application of Machine Learning in Government Service: Take Consumer Protection Service as an Example
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The receiving of consumers' complaints is one of the most important work in government service. The classification of complaints for different industries is a bottleneck in the service flow chart, affecting service efficiency, which also leads to low utilization of data information after complaints are accepted. This paper uses machine learning techniques to help government departments solve the difficult issues of receiving and classifying consumers' complaints. In this paper, Naïve Bayesian algorithm and SVM algorithm are introduced to replace the manual classification in the process. In addition, this paper uses text analysis technology and LDA topic model to cluster industry issues. The visualization result helps government departments visually monitor the changes in the consumer environment and hot issues in the industry can be captured promptly and accurately.

articleTitle: Research on Improving the Government Service Quality by Public Comments Monitoring: Take Suburb Park an Example
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Public service is a very important component in the life of citizens. Under the trend of the Internet economy, the use of online commentary data to assist the public service sector in improving public service satisfaction is an action of implementing service-oriented government. This paper takes the suburb park in Shanghai as an example and conducts research on online review through fine-grained sentiment analysis. Through the techniques of machine learning and natural language processing and drawing portraits of public satisfaction in suburb parks by Python, the visualization results can provide decision-making basis for public service. Finally, based on two of the suburb parks, the regression result on the features and the scores from the actual reviewers shows significant correlations.

articleTitle: Robust Optimization for Vehicle Routing Problem Under Uncertainty in Disaster Response
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The robust optimization problem for emergency logistics in response to disaster is studied in this paper. An improved mixed integer programming model for capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) is developed, which minimizes the total travel cost and unmet demands. Due to the suddenness and unpredictability of disasters, precise information is usually unavailable especially in the early period after the occurrence. Hence the concept of robustness is adopted to handle the uncertainty. The information about demands and travel costs is represented in intervals, which can be estimated based on the historical data. Numerical experiments are conducted and the computational results reveal that the results of the robust optimization model can better balance the total cost and the risk due to the uncertainty.

articleTitle: Storage Systems Management Based on Big Data - Take Three Common Storage Systems as Examples
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Efficient warehousing management has become an inevitable requirement under e-commerce environment with the characteristics of multiple varieties, small batch, multi-batch, short cycle. Warehousing management involves a number of aspects, such as storage rack type decision, the storage assignment decision, and how to classify the goods, what level the load rate of storage locations should maintained at and other specific issues, these issues are important aspects for storage management that affect the operation efficiency of the storage system. In the context of “Big Data + e-Commerce”, single-deep rack storage system, double-deep rack storage system and mobile rack storage system are taken as the examples in this paper, expected travel time models of these three storage systems are set up under different storage policies to analyze the effect of above aspects on the operation efficiency of the storage system by simulation. The ultimate aim of the study is to provide practical reference for e-commerce warehousing management.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model and Solution Approach for Berth Allocation Problem in Tidal Bulk Ports with Different Vessel Draft Requirements
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In this paper, we study a problem of berth allocation for vessels in tidal bulk port terminals. The difference with other studies is that we consider the type of vessels. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to take the different drafts of different types of vessels, and the terminal constraints into account. Some goods cannot be loaded or unloaded at a certain terminal. For instance, some vessels are full of cargo when arriving at terminals and empty when departing or opposite. For this problem, we provide a mathematical formulation, which is solved by a commercial solver and a Genetic Algorithm (GA). We also conduct a numerical experiment.

articleTitle: New Product Development Strategy Based on Crowdsourcing
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Based on crowdsourcing and co-creation, this article constructs a supply chain model of the manufacturer providing improved or innovative product for users to analyze which product type is the optimal decision for the manufacturer. The result shows that when the number of potential users is large or the degree of effort transfer is high, the manufacture provides innovative product, otherwise provides improved product. Furthermore, when the manufacturer chooses the optimal product type, the supplier and users can get more.

articleTitle: Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows in Aged Service: A Delivery Service Model for the Elderly
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In recent years, the number of elderly population is increasing in China with the decline of population mortality and the prolongation of life expectancy. The elderly population is also gradually increasing, making the aging phenomenon more and more serious worldwide. Accompanied by the high demands in material life and spiritual life, people pay more and more attention to pension services. Therefore, the service problem for the elderly arises many researchers' interests. As a typical distribution problem for the elderly, in order to reduce the cost of logistics activities and create more economic benefits for the enterprise, the distribution vehicle routing problem certainly becomes the research hotspot. We firstly introduce the background of the vehicle routing problem with time windows and the delivery service for the elderly. Then we analyze the present situation in both domestic and external research. We also summarize the elements of the elderly distribution problem and classifies the characteristics of this problem through an investigation in a typical Beijing community. Finally, we refine the vehicle routing problem with time windows in the delivery service for the elderly and the corresponding mathematical model is established.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Impact of Negative Online Word-of-Mouth on Consumer's Purchase Intention
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the development of modern e-commerce, shopping online has completely changed the traditional commodity marketing model and consumer habits. More and more consumers use the online medium to distribute unfavorable experiences. Many previous studies have confirmed that negative word-of-mouth has a greater impact on consumers than positive word-of-mouth. However, there are few studies explaining how negative word-of-mouth affect consumers. To fill the existing research gap, this research proposed and empirically tested a negative online word-of-mouth on consumer's purchase intention model, investigating the influence of communicator characteristics, information features and receiver characteristics on trust and consumer's purchase intention. We conducted a survey in the form of a questionnaire and the empirical results showed that negative online word-of-mouth communicator's relationship strength with receiver, recipients' trust tendency and product involvement, significantly influence receivers' purchase intention, while the quantity, quality and information intensity of negative online word-of-mouth, positively affect receivers' trust in word-of-mouth, which further influences their purchase intention. Finally, this research proposed some substantive suggestions on the impact of negative online word-of-mouth on consumer's purchase intention.

articleTitle: The Review and Prospect for Empirical Research on the Determinants of Corporate Cash Holdings
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: After reviewing the related domestic and foreign literature, this article thinks that the company's financial characteristics, corporate governance and the macro environment have a significant influence on cash levels. By comparison, we find that domestic studies focus on the influence of corporate governance structure on the level of cash holdings, the foreign studies are more comprehensive and in-depth not only in sample size and scope of national study, but research methods and research angle. In addition, the macroeconomic environment's influence on the level of cash holdings has not got enough attentions, which needs to be further studied as a important subject for researchers.

articleTitle: Impact of Carbon Tariffs on Jiangsu's Agricultural Products Export Trade and Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper takes the export of agricultural products in Jiangsu Province as the research object, and the OLS method is used to simulate the effects of carbon tariffs on the export of agricultural products. It was found that different tax rates have different effects on the export of agricultural products, and different crops suffer different levels of impact at the same tax rate.

articleTitle: Achieving Successful Aging in Assisted Living Facilities Through Person-Centered Services
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The population of the older adult in China has been continuously increasing at a high speed. It is estimated that in 2020, the population of people above 60 years old will account for 17.8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> of the total population of China in 2020, and 25% in 2030. Because of business opportunities brought by such increase, aging community, an important component of the aging services industry, has developed unprecedentedly these years. According to “Healthy China 2030 Plan” issued by the Central Committee of the Communist Party and the State Council of China, a sound aging service system which benefits all the elderly people will be built in China in 2030. Thus, how to provide sound services in assisted living facilities to promote successful aging is an important social topic needing to be taken efforts on. This paper will discuss how to provide the aging people person-centered services, which means meeting their true needs. By constructing a theoretical model and investigating prior helpful experience, the paper proposes several practical suggestions for assisted living facilities on how to develop in China and how to achieve successful aging from the life-span perspective.

articleTitle: The Impact Factors of Online Book Reviews Usefulness: An Empirical Comparison Between ANN and SVM
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The rapid development of information technology has led to massive online reviews which are generated on the Web, this paper aims to explore the determinants of review helpfulness. In this research, we propose a conceptual model from the perspective of content quality and source quality and incorporate supervised machine learning approaches to learn the impact factors of online book reviews. Specifically, we compared two supervised machine learning algorithms of ANN (Artificial Neural Network) and SVM (Support Vector Machine) and Linear Regression approach. Book reviews are collected from douban.com for ten popular books. We found that long sentences and the extreme emotion is more helpful and can be more persuasive. The empirical findings also indicated that the ANN and SVM algorithms outperformed the ordinary OLS algorithms.

articleTitle: The Impact of Service Value on Customer Buying Decisions of Product-Service Portfolios
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The buying decision of product-service portfolio is affected by the perception of service value and product value. The study reported in this paper explores the impact of service value on buying decisions of product-service portfolios by using event-related potentials (ERPs). Twenty participants were shown product-service portfolios with different service values and were asked to make buying decisions on portfolios with different service value levels. The buying rate and attention-related P2 component in left frontal regions were recorded after the stimuli were shown. The behavioral result shows that the portfolios with higher service value have higher buying rate. The EEG result shows that the P2 component evoked by the portfolio of PS2 (one product and two services) is the largest, which shows different attention resources attracted by portfolios with different service values. Our study explores the impact of different service value on buying decisions of product-service portfolios in both behavioral and neural perspective, providing suppliers a new insight in the design of product-service portfolios.

articleTitle: A Mediated Moderation Model of Work Overload and Mental Health of Professional Service Staff
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Professional service has become an important part of the knowledge economy society, and work overload of professional service staff has seriously affected the mental health. Based on Job Demand-Resource theory, this study investigates the mediating mechanism and boundary conditions of work overload on mental health by investigating 113 employees in one of the big four international accounting firms. The results revealed that work overload was positively correlated with job burnout, and negatively correlated with mental health; supervisor support moderate that work overload influence on mental health; job burnout mediating impacts of work overload and supervisor support on mental health. This study provides a new perspective to reduce the negative effects of professional service employees' work overload on mental health.

articleTitle: Research on Information Transmission on Co-Innovation Platforms
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The failure of a firm's product innovation is mainly due to the mismatch of the product attributes with consumers' preferences. Since consumers' preferences are private, firms try to build some co-innovation platforms so that they can infer consumers' preferences in the process of communicating with consumers on such platforms. This paper models the information transmission process as a signaling game, where a (representative) consumer with two types (N and O) reports his/her preference to a firm via two signals (sn and so). Here, type-N (type-O) indicates that the consumer really likes a innovative (an original) product while signal sn (so) means that the consumer says that he/she likes the innovative (original) product. We identity conditions under which the consumer is willing to truthfully convey his/her preference type to the firm (perhaps via different signals) in the sense of a separate perfect Bayesian equilibriums (PBEs). When the consumer's extra participation utility goes beyond a threshold, the separating equilibrium reveals that type-N (type-O) consumer sends the signal sn (so), no matter how large the reputational loss is. When the reputational loss is low enough, the separating equilibrium reveals that type-N (type-O) consumer sends the signal sn (so), no matter how large the extra utility is. These results reveal the information transmission role of product co-innovation platforms in facilitating the match between product attributes and consumers' preferences and thus reducing the failure possibility of product innovation.

articleTitle: Optimal Pricing and Service Quality Strategies for Monopoly Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper considers the impact of service quality on two-sided markets and studies the optimal pricing problems for a monopoly platform. Considering that improving service quality commonly brings a non-linear operation cost, the platform can adjust its registration prices and service quality to balance the cost and the earnings, so as to maximize its profit. This paper shows that the monopoly platform has three kinds of strategies: offering a high service quality and charging two high registration prices; offering a lowest service quality and charging two cheaper registration prices; exiting the two-sided market when there is no profit space. Furthermore, the sensitivity analysis on the service cost parameter, the user price sensitivity and the cross-group externalities is proposed to provide some important management insights for the platform.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Development Level of Logistics Industry for Each Region in Shanxi Province
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In order to evaluate the logistic industry development level of each region in Shanxi Province, firstly, we set up an evaluation index system. Secondly, based on the data in 2015, we apply grey relational analysis model, entropy weight evaluation model and location entropy evaluation model to evaluate the logistics development level of different regions in Shanxi province. The results showed that the logistics development level of Taiyuan is the highest, and Jincheng is the lowest. Finally, we put forward some suggestions to improve the whole level of logistic development in Shanxi Province.

articleTitle: Optimization Approach to Station Location of Car Sharing System
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In recent years vehicle sharing has developed rapidly because it can reduce traffic congestion and increase mobility. At present, China's carsharing enterprises are still in the development stage, and there exist problems like imbalance between supply and demand resulting from one-way carsharing service which allow customers to return cars at any station. In this paper, I develop and solve a MILP model for rental station location taking into vehicle relocation problem at the same time. And the optimization objective is minimizing the cost of system construction and the travel cost of users. The model is applied to a numerical sample, and the results provide useful insights regarding the efficient planning of one-way carsharing system and allow decision makers to quantify the trade-off between company's and user's cost.

articleTitle: The Pricing Strategy for the Dual Channel Supply Chain with Pre-Sale Service
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In this paper, we study a dual-channel supply chain with a retailer offering pre-sale service. We integrate the consumer utility into the dual-channel Stackelberg game model. We analyze the impact of pre-sale service and dual-channel marketing on the supply chain design and its optimal pricing decisions. We find that online direct channel improves the supply chain's profit by indirectly increasing the retailer's profits. Also, pre-sale service only helps improve the supply chain's performance within certain interval of the service level. Supply chain may not always benefit from the higher service level due to the higher costs.

articleTitle: Method Development and Comparative Study of P2P Agricultural Loan Selection
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper aims to solve the problem of borrower selection in the agricultural credit business field. Instead of calculating the probability of default exactly, we focus on the credit ranking of the borrowers. Two integrated methods and a comparative study is presented. Computational results show that the Integrated Weighting-PROMETHEE II Method outperforms other methods with respect to practical operation due to its efficiency, objectiveness and stability.

articleTitle: The Optimal Strategies of Online Car-Hailing Platform Based on the Cost Difference of Drivers
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Recent years, the car-hailing platforms have been booming in the market, such as Didi and Uber. These platforms have a common characteristic, that is to allow the service providers to decide how often to work by themselves. According to the demand condition, the platform can match supply and demand through pricing strategy. In this paper, based on the problem of the pricing strategy of the car-hailing platform, we develop the model which the platform adjusts demand and supply to maximizes its profit. We get the optimal price and wage. It means that the car-hailing platform can improve its profit by strategically pricing.

articleTitle: Research on the Effect of Willingness to Use in Unmanned Restaurants: An Integrated Model
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In the context of the unmanned restaurant becoming the catering boom, unmanned restaurants are finding critical factors that affect the willingness of customers to use. Combined with the actual situation of the unmanned restaurant, this paper studies the influencing factors of consumers' willingness to use by establishing a theoretical model (i.e. statistically relationships among the perceived benefit, perceived value and usage intention). The model are tested on the sample of the consumers group and the results partially supported our research hypothesis. Additionally, this paper will provide some suggestions for unmanned restaurants to promote customer consumption.

articleTitle: Perceived Brand Loyalty Toward Taiwanese Advanced Electronics Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In today's modern life., when people are getting busier and busier; laptop computers., notepads., and mobile phones with their merit functions are seen as the indispensable fellow-traveller to many people. In light of this trend., laptop makers., especially in Taiwan have concentrated on information technology (IT) to build a solid foundation of research., development and branding., as well as a comprehensive supply chain covering design., manufacturing., marketing and branding functions. This study's objective is to report on Taiwanese laptops brand and the influences among country of origin (COO)., perceived brand awareness (PBA)., brand image/association (BI/A)., perceived brand quality (PBQ) and perceived brand loyalty (PBL). In doing so., seven maj or hypotheses were tested through structured questionnaire and statistical analyses. A total sample of 402 respondents., from 19 different countries is used to test the hypotheses via statistical tools (Cronbach‘s alpha., factor analysis and regression model) and with the aid of SPSS software. As a result., all the predetermined hypotheses are accepted which means that there are significant influences among country of origin., brand awareness., brand image/association., perceived brand quality and perceived brand loyalty toward Taiwanese brand. Implications of the study may be used as references for the planning of marketing strategies and as the basis for future researches in the consumer behaviour with regard to Taiwanese laptop brands

articleTitle: Sales Forecast for O2O Services - Based on Incremental Random Forest Method
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper proposes an incremental random forest method to forecast the sales for the O2O take-out business. The proposed method has two characteristics. First, we identify the important features that contribute most to the forecast accuracy by deleting the noisy features. This feature selection process helps to improve the forecast accuracy. Second, we use an incremental method based on random forest by adding incremental features and focus on sales increment prediction. This incremental random forest method could further help to control the forecast error. Moreover, we apply a real data set from an online merchant in one of the largest O2O platforms to validate our method. The results show that the feature selection can significantly reduce the mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) by 11.64%. Furthermore, the incremental random forest method further reduces the MAPE by 3.10%. With a better sales forecast, the merchant can improve its operations for replenishment and marketing.

articleTitle: Omni-Channel Operations with Showrooms and Consumer Returns
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Retailers are puzzled by customer returns all along the time. As e-commerce develops rapidly, customers can't observe the product in the online shops and it results in more returns. In the omni-channel environment, offline showrooms are adopted to attract more customers to the offline stores. We think showrooms can help the store have more customers and we prove it with our models. Then we think this's a way to reduce returns in certain conditions. Our results can be expressed: 1) when the offline operating cost isn't so large or the return cost is large, the retailer can gain more profit by providing a showroom; 2) showrooms decrease the retailer's profit when the offline operating cost is large or the return cost isn't so large. Therefore, retailers should consider all related factors to decide whether to provide an offline showroom.

articleTitle: Research on Auto Sales Forecast Based on Online Reviews-Take R Brand Automobile as an Example
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The rapid development of automobile industry has led to the blind expansion of the production capacity of various auto companies, which has brought serious potential overcapacity. Accurate forecaste of car sales is not only of great importance to automobile manufacturers and distributors in setting up strategy and target. It also has a certain influence on the good growth of China's automobile market and the healthy development of the national economy. This article takes R brand automobile as the research object, collects the related online reviews data, through the natural language processing and the text emotion model, the online reviews data is processed quantitatively. The sales forecasts are made by combining the internal historical sales data of the automobile company with the online reviews of R brand and the sales and reviews data of competitive brands. Compared with the benchmark model, it is found that the sales forecasting model which has added the sentiment variables and the influence factors of the competitive brands improves the fitting ability of the data.

articleTitle: Surgery Scheduling Study of Deputy Surgeons and Assistants Based on MIP
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Surgeons often need other surgeons' cooperation when performing operations. Usually, there are several operation rooms to choose in hospitals. How to arrange the surgeries with surgeons is a vital problem to ensure the completion of all the surgery successfully and the balanced use of operation rooms. Moreover, it is of great significance to reduce the idle time for surgeons to wait for surgeries. In practice, the surgery scheduling in a hospital is usually done one day before. Thus, the current research mainly focuses on the surgery scheduling of the following day which is known as short-term scheduling. Three types of surgeons are considered in the current research, i.e. master operators, deputy operators and assistants. Each surgery needs more than two surgeons, i.e. a master or deputy operator requires one another deputy operator or assistant to assist them to complete the surgery successfully. According to the surgery arrangement of master operators and deputy operators, this paper consider operators and assistants in his/her spare time to help other surgeons' surgeries. Furthermore, the current paper formulates a mathematical model based on mixed integer linear programming (MILP) to arrange the surgeries of deputy operators and assistants reasonably and reduce their idle time. An experiment from practice is tested to illustrate valid and efficient of the model proposed.

articleTitle: Construction and Representation of Shipping Domain Ontology Based on Ontology Design Patterns
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Shipping data is one of the important contents of open government data. Linked data is the highest standard and effective way to improve the openness of shipping data. Ontology is also the core step and key link for building shipping linked data. In order to solve the problem of the lack of domain ontology support for the construction of shipping linked data, and also to absorb and learn from the excellent ideas and best practices of other ontology construction, this paper introduces typical ontology design patterns and realizes a method for constructing a shipping ontology basing on the design patterns. The obtained ontology is encoded in a machine readable format to meet the automatic processing requirements of the application program. The research results of this paper not only provide a set of feasible ontology solutions for the construction of shipping linked data, but also provide some reference for the ontology construction practice in other fields basing on the design patterns.

articleTitle: Pre-Visit Destination Image's Effects on Perceived Travel Service Quality: The Mediating Effects of Place Attachment
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: As a competition goes fiercer, more and more destination managers hope to attract first-time tourists by improving destination image. However, few researches pay attention to first-time tourists' pre-visit destination image's effects on travel service quality. The aim of this study is to explore the relationship between destination image and service quality by introducing destination attachment as mediate variable. The proposed model was empirically verified through a survey of 752 first-time tourists and tested by using SEM method. The findings demonstrate that: (1) tourist's pre-visit cognitive image positively influence affective image; (2) pre-visit cognitive image's positive effect on perceived service quality is partially mediated by place dependence; (3) place identity fully mediates the positive relationship between pre-visit cognitive image and perceived service quality.

articleTitle: Research on Competitiveness of Vehicle-Freight Matching Platform for Carrier
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Recent years have witnessed more and more “Internet + logistics” enterprises in practice, among which the vehicle-freight matching platform is the most common. This paper investigates the competitiveness of different platform enterprises for the carriers in the market. By analyzing the research and development situations home and abroad, we select four representative platforms, Huochebang, Yunmanman, Kaxintianxia, Tiandihui, as the analysis objects. We first construct the evaluation index system on the competitiveness of the vehicle-freight matching platform, and then use analytic hierarchy process to determine the weight of each evaluation index. Finally, we apply the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to evaluate the selected platforms and obtain their competitiveness level. The evaluation index system constructed and the research conclusions in this paper can facilitate the carrier when choosing a vehicle-freight matching platform.

articleTitle: Cost-Sensitive Semi-Supervised Ensemble Model for Customer Churn Prediction
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Customer churn prediction is a vital part of customer relationship management. In real churn prediction modeling, the process of assigning labels to customers is costly and time-consuming, and thus there are more unlabeled than labeled samples. To solve this problem, this study combines semi-supervised learning, cost-sensitive learning method Metacost with ensemble method random subspace to propose a semi-supervised ensemble model based on Metacost. This model includes the following three stages: (1) use the Metacost method to modify the class label of the initial labeled training set to obtain a new training set; (2) label the unlabeled samples selectively; (3) train several basic classifiers with the final training set and use them to classify the samples in the test set. The empirical results for two customer churn prediction data sets demonstrate that the proposed model raises customer churn prediction performance compared with commonly used supervised ensemble and semi-supervised models.

articleTitle: Study on Cooperation Strategies Between Supply Chain Enterprises Based on Evolutionary Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the rapid development of social economy, the management modes of those traditional enterprises have failed to give an instant reaction to changes in the market. However, with the advent of supply chain management model, changes in the market could be quickly responded. The cooperation between supply chain companies is not only cooperation but also competition, making the game between companies inevitable. This paper builds an evolutionary game model for suppliers and manufacturers in the supply chain, analyzes the influencing factors of the two strategies' behaviors, and finds that the probability of cooperation between the two is positively correlated with excess returns, negatively related to total investment costs and betrayal returns. At the same time, there is an optimal way to distribute excess returns so that the possibility of cooperation between the two parties is maximized. Based on this, the countermeasures and suggestions for effectively promoting active cooperation among supply chain enterprises are proposed.

articleTitle: A Penny Saved vs. a Penny Earned: Examining the Influence of Consumers' Regulatory Focus on Frugality
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Research about consumers' decision to be frugal has been ignored in the field of consumer behavior and marketing. This paper is aimed to examine the influence of individuals' regulatory focus on frugality. Regulatory focus theory argues that individuals pursue goals in different ways - promotion orientation focus on hopes, gains and accomplishments, while prevention orientation will be more concerned with safety, responsibilities, and obligations. This paper proposed that, compared to promotional focus, individuals with prevention focus tend to be more frugal. In study 1, we experimentally induced the participants' regulatory focus and found the prevention orientation saved more and spend less than the promotion orientation after receiving an unexpected gain. In study 2, a field survey indicated that their chronic regulatory focus (promotion minus prevention) was negatively related to frugality, and the impulsiveness mediated the influencing process. Theoretical and practical implications will be discussed.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Energy Saving Effect of Energy Efficiency Retrofit of Existing Residential Buildings in Cold Area
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In this paper, two residential demonstration projects are selected to analyze the energy saving effect of EER of existing residential buildings in cold area China case of China. Based on the theory of building energy consumption, calculation data of two cases of actual testing data, compared with the actual effect of energy saving by building energy consumption indexes of EER projects to sum up the energy conservation contribution of EER technical measures in cold area. The important findings are: a) the energy-saving reconstruction of existing buildings in the cold area of China can bring significant energy saving and emission reduction effects; b) the energy saving distribution of the external wall retrofit of the inefficient buildings in the cold area takes up the largest part of energy saving by building envelope, and the second is the EER of external windows; c) the energy saving EER of existing building envelope must synchronize with the indoor heating system retrofit and heating metering and charging system, otherwise, the phenomenon of “energy-efficient building do not save energy” will happen.

articleTitle: The Influence of Own-Product's Online Reviews on the Sales of Market Substitute Products
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Whether and how online reviews of one commodity's homogeneous goods affect the sales of itself. By using multiple linear regression model, We find the number of reviews, the score of products, the percentage of positive or negative reviews, the number of words of reviews, and the level of the commentators do have impacts on the sales of product. We also find the online review valence and volume of itself have a positive impact on the sales of its own products, but the online review valence and volume of their market substitute products have a negative impact on the sales of its own product.

articleTitle: System- Wide Sustainability Factors and Strategies for Big Data Center
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Big data centers play an important role in the current IT infrastructure, but they are also the main contributors of the carbon dioxide emissions, and their impact on resource consumption and environmental pollution will continue to increase in the coming years. At present, many scholars have been discussing how technology can reduce pollution, increase resource utilization, and predict data center energy consumption. Based on these studies, this paper analyzes the major components of energy consumption in a big data center, and proposes a system-wide energy consumption strategy to reduce its carbon emissions. The discussion of this paper can help a firm manager to effectively build and manage a sustainable big data center.

articleTitle: The Impacts of Carbon Tax Policy on a Remanufacturing Supply Chain and its Implications
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: To reduce carbon emissions, more and more countries are imposing a series of legislations, such as carbon tax policy. This paper develops a game model to analyze pricing decisions of a remanufacturing supply chain under the constraint of the carbon tax policy. Meanwhile, we analyze the impacts of the carbon tax on optimal prices and production quantity of new (remanufactured) products, the profits for the manufacturer and remanufacturer, total carbon emissions and the remanufacturing rate. In addition, we analyze the impacts of the carbon tax on the equilibrium results by using numerical studies. Such analytical results throw clear insights in to the role of consumer's willingness-to-pay for the remanufactured product. It is hoped that all these conclusions and managerial implications may provide reference for the manufacturer and remanufacturer to optimize decisions under the carbon tax policy, and provide some theoretical basis for the government to adjust and design incentive policies.

articleTitle: The Optimal Strategies of Free Gift Card Program with External Market
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Sales promotion has become a popular tool for retailers to deal with the intense competition in the product market, and the gift card program is a common one. Moreover, with the rapid development of e-commerce and mobile Internet, the external market of gift cards is gradually forming. This paper mainly uses consumer's valuation of products and its distribution function to describe consumer's decision-making behavior, on this basis, we construct the retailers' profit optimization model. Then we analyze the conditions for retailers to conduct gift card program and the optimal promotion strategy. After this, we further analyze the effects of different factors on the optimal strategy.

articleTitle: Technology Threats:Impacts of Cyberbullying to Today's Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This study is aimed to examine the impact of cyberbullying in the 21st century generation, how social media and technology contributes into the rising cases of cyberbullying. Studies were carried out in two folds. (1) We carried out online surveys on a small cohort to record general experiences of cyberbullying on social network platforms and we report our findings using qualitative and quantitative data analysis techniques. (2) We classified tweets into `bully' and `non-bully' based on the presence of bully related words in the tweets and develop a model using NLP techniques in order to flag new tweets which are bully related. The findings of the study indicated that most participants use their social media platforms daily with a high proportion of them using Facebook, WeChat or WhatsApp. The results of the study also reflected that cyberbullying is real and affects victims emotionally, physically and mentally and most people disregard the impact. This study contributes to the knowledge of research in this domain and can be used to flag tweets which contain fowl words or attack individuals for the necessary action to be taken, consequently, to reduce cyberbullying in online social networks.

articleTitle: Effect of Trade Credit Insurance in Factoring Finance
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In this paper, we consider supply chain finance models consisting a capital-constrained retailer, a supplier, a factor and a credit insurance company. Through the comparisons of models, we study the effect of factoring finance and trade credit insurance on these participants. We find that factoring finance is indeed a profitable service for upstream SMEs, especially in recession time. Furthermore, trade credit insurance, insured by the supplier, can also reduce the factor's risk.

articleTitle: Research on the Characteristics of Chinese Manufacturing Industry Social Network
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper uses the social network analysis method to analyze the “relationship” between the subjects and explores the features of the global manufacturing trade network. The results of the analysis show that the manufacturing links between countries have become increasingly close and continuous; the centrality, contact strength and heterogeneity of social networks in China have been analyzed, indicating that China is gradually occupying a central position and controlling most trade resources. The contact with trading partners is getting closer.

articleTitle: A Combinned Control Chart to Monitor Small Process Mean
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This article proposes a new control chart, which has better performance in detecting small shifts. It combines npx and CRL control chart, and the ring gage is used to classified conforming and nonconforming items. The combined chart employs attribute inspection which is easier to operate in monitoring. At the same time, the combined chart makes up for the shortcomings of the lack of accuracy of the attribute chart, it performs well when the mean shift is small.

articleTitle: Does Information Technology Capability Affect Internal Control Disclosure? Evidence From China
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The study of the relationships between information technology (IT) and firm performance is a cutting-edge research topic for the information systems (IS) community. Several studies support the positive link between information technology capability and firm performance. Drawing on the perspective of IT investment capabilities and the literature on internal control, in this study, we develop conjectures for understanding how the IT capability affects the level of internal control disclosure. Using the ordered logistic model with data from 2011 to 2014 of Chinese marketing, we find that IT capability plays a significant role in improving the firms' internal control disclosure. Our results suggest that because of the positive link between the IT capability and the internal control disclosure, the future study can focus more on the relationship between IT capability and external factors, such as audit and investment.

articleTitle: Modelling the Ridesharing Program in the Morning Commute Problem with Parking Space Constraint
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper extends the ridesharing model in the morning commute problem with parking space constraint. Commuters are categorized into three roles: solo driver, ridesharing driver and ridesharing passenger. The new equilibrium model is proposed to illustrate commuters' choices. The analytical results show that the scarcity of parking spaces encourages commuters to participate in ridesharing. With an increasing ridesharing rate, commuters' generalized travel cost will be reduced consequently.

articleTitle: Research on Location of Distribution Service Window: Taking Power Supply Bureau in a City as an Example
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The logistics process management of electric power material greatly affects the operation efficiency of power grid corporation. The location of power material warehouse have indirect effect on the operational efficiency of corporation by influencing the total cost of logistics and overall service quality. Since the warehouse location network of power supply bureau in A city (the subsidiary company of one famous power grid corporation in China) is dispersed and the warehouses service area is overlapping with an excessive number of warehouses and high inventory, and to reduce the relevant expense at a high service quality, a facility location optimization strategy of setting up distribution service window is proposed. When it comes to decide the number of the distribution service window, a generalized maximum coverage model based on grid proposed in this paper, which can provides a new thought when determining warehouse quantity of continuous location issue. Afterwards, this paper uses the P-median model to determine the location of distribution service window based on least-cost principle. The example proves the rationality and validity of the optimization strategy, which has certain practical significance.

articleTitle: Ensemble Clustering via Learning Representations from Auto-Encoder
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Representation learning is central to clustering analysis and visualization. However, linear dimension reduction methods cannot model high dimensional and sparse feature spaces, thus may neglect some important information during feature representation. In this paper, we focus on developing effective models to capture non-linear and most salient features for clustering analysis, and propose an ensemble framework ECLRA to fuse different layer representations from auto-encoders. To further improve the clustering performance and fully realize the potential of ensemble learning, we also design a strategy to generate enough basic partitions, which turns out to be very effective. Experimental results demonstrate that ECLRA can significantly improve clustering performance compared with baseline methods, and are fairly robust on imbalanced datasets.

articleTitle: The Influencing Factors of Social Elderly Care Service Demand: A Meta-Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: By meta-analysis, we conduct a quantitative analysis of 98 independent studies between 2003 and 2016 to explore the influencing factors of social elderly services demand and their impact mechanisms. The results show that: (a)health, education, dwell, income, the charge and quality of service are the main factors that affect the social elderly service demand; (b) the differences among endowment patterns have regulating effects on the influencing mechanism of each factor; (c) the dislocation between the payment capacity of the elderly and the supply of services essentially results in the imbalance between supply and demand of social elderly services.

articleTitle: A Remanufacturing Closed-Loop Supply Chain Model Considering Disassembly During New Product Design Stage
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The disassembly of waste products is an important part of remanufacturing activities. The difficulty of disassembly has an important impact on the remanufacturing cost, the parts quality and the remanufacturing cycle. It assumes that the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) considers disassembly during new product design stage. Accordingly, it will generate invested costs associated with disassembly level and reduce remanufacturing cost. It sets up a two-stage programming model with constraint to maximize OEM's profit and obtains the optimal disassembly level and optimal pricing strategies by using Kuhn-Tucker condition. It carries out the sensitivity analysis of the decision variables and the objective function by means of analytical methods and numerical examples.

articleTitle: Manufacturers' Optimal Consumer Rebate Strategy in Competitive Market
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Under a competitive market composed of two exclusive supply chains, this paper examines manufacturers' optimal rebate strategy and its impact on manufacturers' and retailers' wholesale prices, selling prices and profits, etc. We also study optimal rebate strategy considering rebate costs and the retailer's optimal subsidy strategy. By establishing and solving a three-stage dynamic game model, we find that (1) when the competition intensity is not very strong, the rebate competition among manufacturers leads to a win-win situation for all manufacturers and retailers. (2) considering rebate cost, manufacturers may fall into prisoner's dilemma under certain conditions. (3) with subsidy, by paying an arbitrarily small subsidy to retailer's respective manufacturer, manufacturers may be willing to offer rebate, sometimes the other manufacturer will offer rebate voluntarily without subsidy.

articleTitle: The Early-Warning and Control of Service Complaint Based on Time Series Forecasting Method and SPC Model-Take Ctrip as an Example
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper applies theories and methods of time series model, emotional classification model, statistical process control (SPC) model and natural language processing to complaint management, and gives basic framework, processes and methods of collecting, using, predicting and analyzing the complaint data in complaint management. By verifying the effect of specific forecasting model which combines the emotional classification of external big data, early-warning model and text mining based on LDA model, the result of the experiment, taking Ctrip as an example, shows that it effectively improves the capability of searching and solving the complaints resulting from service failure, optimizing corporate services, and improving the timeliness and effectiveness of industry supervision.

articleTitle: Open the Quality or Not? The Analysis of Information Strategy on Cournot Competition
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Competing firms often have private information about the quality of their products before producing stage. While nowadays, some firms would like to make the quality information public, which leads to the quality information sharing between competitors. This paper studies the incentive for the quality information sharing between competing firms who sell substitutable products under Cournot market. The equilibrium output quantities and the corresponding sale prices for two products are analyzed under the scenarios of information sharing and no information sharing respectively. The result shows that under both information structures, the firm with higher degree of quality produces more products and sets higher price. Compared with no information sharing case, information sharing enables the firm with higher degree of quality to increase its producing quantity and sale price. Moreover, sharing quality information is the dominant strategy of two firms, since sharing information allows competitive firms to make their decisions more rationally and realize a win-win situation. This research provides useful managerial insights for firms to decide whether to share quality information or not.

articleTitle: Inventory-Location Problem with Considering Lateral Transshipment Under Route-Like Demands
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the distribution system consisting of two logistics nodes, describes lateral transshipment strategy in this scenario, establishes a mathematical model of inventory-location problem with considering lateral transshipment under route-like demands, and designs a heuristic algorithm combining implicit enumeration method and linear programming algorithm. This paper verifies the necessity and feasibility of the model. It is concluded that taking into account the lateral transshipment strategy at the operational level affects the decision-making of facility's location at the strategic level and can reduce the total operating cost of the logistics nodes system.

articleTitle: Ambulance Location Problems and Cost-Effective Analysis with Time-Dependent Demand and Speed
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In this paper, an EMS cost-effective model is adopted in multi-period environment to minimize the social cost. The ACO algorithm is improved to adjust to the model. With the variation in demands and speeds over time, different deployments is taken to obtain the optimal plan. This paper applied the model to the data from Songjiang District in Shanghai. The empirical results show that the deployment plan based on the mulita-period model can reduce the total cost by 5.25% compared with the static model.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Impact of Government Audit on the Performance of State-Owned Energy Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The government audit results from the public Accountability, the fulfillment of economic responsibilities and economic activities are ultimately reflected in the business performance of the company. Therefore, this paper takes the state-owned energy listed company as research object, selects the representative central energy listed company as the sample data, and empirically studies the impact of the government audit on its performance. The empirical results show that after the intervention of the government audit, the performance of state-owned energy listed companies can be effectively improved and the operating results can be optimized.

articleTitle: What Effects do Recommendations Have on Customers' Online Purchasing Willingness? An Empirical Study from WeChat Official Accounts
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the increasing market share of WeChat in mobile constant messaging application, there are large amounts of sellers establishing official accounts in WeChat. Many of these accounts would make recommendations to customers. But whether these recommendations work and what effects they will have remain to be studied. In this paper, we investigate the key factors influencing customers' online shopping intentions, in the context of recommendations from WeChat official accounts. Based on Expectation Confirmation Model, we add some special situation factors to extend our conceptual model. Results indicate the importance of users' trust towards official accounts, since trust influences users' perceived usefulness and attitude, which are positively related to purchasing willingness. It is suggested that sellers should gain more trust from consumers, and improving reputation of official accounts can be helpful. This analysis model can offer important implications for commercial activities in WeChat, and provide some useful advice for official accounts.

articleTitle: Contemporary University Institutional Governance from Service Quality Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The impact coming from over-abundance of university institutions coupled with the low fertility is the thorniest issue for Taiwan university governance. Attendant to this, the relations between subject and subordinate, that is, between schools and students undergo a subtle change. Apart from the conventional pedagogy and researches, and the recruitment issue, university nowadays needs to provide students with satisfactory service quality so that on-the-go recruitment can become feasible. As said, how to make the quality service a workable project becomes an important indicator for university governance. This study surveyed a wide spectrum of literatures on the university governance essences and indicators, and invites 17 presidents from public and private university institutions using modified Delphi method (MDM) to establish suitable university management indicators. In addition, this study pinpoints the detail differences between public and private universities' tuition fees, differences between general university/technology university, and university locations. The results of the present study suggest that more efforts should be made in school-running attributes in the future, considering the importance of internal governance indicator; that is, university education needs to cover service management characteristic.

articleTitle: Study on the Impact of China's Shadow Banks on Monetary Policy
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper selects relevant monthly data from January 2013 to March 2017, and analyzes the effect of shadow banking on the implementation of monetary policy by establishing a VAR model. The results show that in the short run, rapid expansion of China's shadow banking system will Influencing all levels of indicators in the process of monetary policy transmission,and weaken the effectiveness of monetary policy instruments by affecting money supply mainly.But in the long run,Shadow banking has no obvious effect on the effect of monetary policy.

articleTitle: Coordination of Fresh Agricultural Product Supply Chain with Dual Channels Under Price and Fresh-Keeping Effort Dependent Demand
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This electronic document is a “live” template and already defines the components of your paper [title, text, heads, etc.] in its style sheet. The pricing and fresh-keeping strategy is studied in the fresh agricultural product supply chain(FAPSC) composed of one supplier and one retailer. The retailer is in charge of selling the fresh agricultural products(FAP) through both online and offline channels. The supplier is in charge of producing FAP. The demand is affected by the retail price charged by the retailer and the fresh-keeping effort taken by the supplier. The optimal decisions of the centralized and decentralized FAPSC are analyzed and compared. The results show that the centralized FAPSC takes a higher fresh keeping effort and gains more profit. The revenue-sharing(RS) contract and revenue and fresh-keeping cost-sharing(RFCS) contract are proposed to coordinate the decentralized FAPSC. A numerical example are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the contracts. The results show that both contracts can increase the profit of the decentralized FAPSC, while the RFCS contract can ensure that the decentralized FAPSC perform as the centrailzed one.

articleTitle: Forecasting Portfolio Risks in Futures Markets Using the GARCH-VaR Model
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the increase of financial transactions in recent decades, forecasting risk of financial products has become more and more challenging, though it's of great significance to financial companies and investors. Fortunately, the accumulation of huge valuable records from trading platforms has provided strong support for solving this issue. In this paper, we proposed a GARCH-VaR model for forecasting the risk of investors' portfolios. We consider both of the volatility of futures and the available fund for each account in GARCH-VaR. Specifically, we first preprocessed settlement prices and holding positions data, and then labeled the samples with whether extreme losses occur. In the second step, we calculated the volatility of all futures and their correlation coefficient matrix. Finally, we forecasted the risk probability of investors' daily positions. Experimental results on the transaction data of the futures company showed the effectiveness of our proposed approach.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Development of Logistics Industry in China: For Provinces and Regions
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In the 40 years since the reform and opening up, China's logistics industry has made great progress, but there is still the problem of uneven development in various provinces and regions. This paper selects three first-level indicators and 18 second-level indicators to establish an evaluation index system for the development level of the logistics industry. The three primary indicators include infrastructure indicators, scale indicators and external environmental indicators. By using the grey relational analysis and Entropy weight method to evaluate China's logistics industry development level, and compare logistics industry development level of provinces and regions. It is concluded that the cause of the provinces and regional logistics industry development level is uneven. Finally, according to the actual situation provide suggestions for the development of logistics industry in future.

articleTitle: Optimal manufacturing or remanufacturing decisions with consideration of supplier's DfR effort
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Closed-loop supply chain emerged as a popular research topic given its strong academic potential and the increasing environmental stress worldwide. This study focuses on closed-loop supply chain systems, which consists of a manufacturer and a supplier, and explores optimal pricing and remanufacturing decisions in closed-loop supply chains by considering the supplier’s DfR (Design for Remanufacturing) effort. In this model, the supplier provides new components for manufacturers and decides the wholesale price and DfR effort of new components. The manufacturer produces new and remanufactured products and sells two kinds of products to the same market. The model is analysed using centralised and decentralised models.
