Some managerial insights are obtained, which provide decision guidelines for enterprises by considering supplier effort.

articleTitle: New Valid Inequalities and Combinatorial Benders' Cuts Algorithm for the Quayside Operation Optimization Problem Without Big-M Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper studies the quayside operation problem, in which three seaside planning decisions are integrated, with the objective of minimizing the maximum relative tardiness. A refinement of the state-of-the-art formulation is presented in this work, and an improved exact combinatorial Benders decomposition algorithm is devised for the problem at container terminals which used to be typically modeled by mixed-integer linear programming problems containing a large number of “big-M” coefficients.

articleTitle: Is GEM Listing Meaningful to the Company?
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The current overall development of China's GEM is good, but there are still problems such as the listed companies' ability to maintain sustainable growth and the opportunity to borrow money for listing. This article analyzes the 54 companies listed on the GEM of the information transmission, software and information technology service industries and concludes that the overall change in total profits is declining and is linear with the industry's full cost characteristics, main business income, and listing conditions. Positively related conclusions have drawn that the industry still has the motivation of artificially manipulating accounting statements and the weak ability of sustainable growth.

Author Keywords: software and information technology service industry
total profit before and after listing changes

articleTitle: A Visualization Framework to Empower Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises in Open Innovation
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Open innovation is a clear and present challenge for many technology companies. It is important to develop an organizational framework to deal with these challenges in a flexible, open, and agile manner. With limited resource, it is vital to manage a catapult mechanism of open innovation for small and medium-sized enterprises. The author attempts to coin a new organizational framework to cope with this issue. In order to empower flexible virtual teams in the framework, the author proposes a 2-dimensional visualization framework to leverage open innovation from bottom up organizational activities for innovation. Then, the author summarizes the outcome of self-managed open innovation mini-projects with the proposed framework. Finally, the author describes a 3-stage model for mini-iteration of organizational growth for open innovation to follow-up the early stage.

articleTitle: Effects of Venture Capital Networks on IPOs Earnings Management
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper aims to explore the relationship between venture capital network and earnings management of IPO enterprises, considering that venture capitals always cooperate to support them. We use discretionary accruals as the indicator of earnings management and social network analysis to capture venture capital network centrality with a sample of 228 listed companies. The empirical results show that the degree centrality is positively related to earnings management, meanwhile, the closeness centrality and betweenness centrality have no significant effects on earnings management.

articleTitle: Market Orientation, Logistical Synergistic Capability and Performance: 3PLs User Perspective
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The way market orientations facilitate firm performance is a key issue for firms and research scholars, especially with the increasing international market competition, more and more companies achieve market-oriented goals with external coordination. In logistics outsourcing background, based on the resource-based theory and synergy theory, this paper builds up the model of logistical synergistic capability and its mediating effect on the relationship between market orientation and business performance through in-depth interviews and questionnaire survey. The empirical results show that logistical synergistic capability is consisted of four dimensions including external strategic synergy, external managerial synergy, external and internal operational synergy, internal managerial synergy that mediate the relationship between customer orientation and business performance. This means in order to improve performance through customer-oriented strategy a company needs to make an effort on logistical synergistic capability.

articleTitle: Exploring the Factors on the Fixed Pricing of Real Time Data Products: A Dual Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the factors affecting the fixed pricing of real-time data products mainly through customer perceived value and data score, using data visualization tools and regression assumptions. The article uses the complex network analysis software GEPHI to quantitatively analyze and draw the visual spectrum of the relationship between the price of realtime data products and the factors influencing the possibility, and conduct general regression analysis on this basis. Through a dual argument, we get the fixed price of real-time data products key influencing factors in order to provide constructive solutions for the pricing of data products.

articleTitle: Markov SCGM(1, l)c Forecasting Model of Knowledge Intensive Industry in Henan Province
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The development of Knowledge Intensive Industry (KIBS) is becoming more and more important. Therefore, it is especially necessary to predict the added value of the industry. In this paper, we regard the added value of Henan province's KIBS from 1992 to 2016 as original data series, applying a single gene system cloud grey SCGM(1,1)c model to imitate the entire tendency; its error index is stochastic fluctuate, then forecasting the error state by Markov theory; at last predicting the coming 3 year's added value through a combined Markov SCGM(1,1)c model, the result shows that the model has good forecast accuracy.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Performance Between Quantitative Funds and Non-Quantitative Funds —Based on Chinese a Share Stock
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In China, quantitative investment is in a rapid development stage. However, relative researches about performance of quantitative investment are few. This article aims to use performance evaluation indicators, including risk and return indicators, and the stock-picking and timing selection abilities which are based on T-M model to do empirical comparative study between Chinese quantitative funds and similar non-quantitative funds. Empirical results show that from March 31,2016 to March 31,2017 period:(1) the risk indicators of quantitative funds are generally smaller than the non-quantitative funds, and return indicators of quantitative funds are larger than non-quantitative funds as a whole;(2) although the timing selection ability and stock-picking ability of quantitative funds and non-quantitative funds are insignificant in statistically, but quantitative funds generally has positive timing selection ability and the higher positive stock-picking ability, rather than non-quantitative funds generally has negative timing selection ability and lower positive stock-picking ability.

articleTitle: Pricing of New Mobile Phone Under the Impact of Recycling Service
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Based on a nationwide survey in China, an integrated model is proposed in this research, incorporating demand of new mobile phone with the availability of a return program and level of return reward. Optimal selling price of new mobile phone, return reward and overall profit all increased under the integrated model. This research bridges the gap in existing literature, incentivizing both the manufacturer and consumers to participate in mobile phone recycling program and notably increases the recycling quantity of mobile phones.

articleTitle: The Impact of Different Design Characteristics of Warning Message on Users' Perceived Usefulness and Perceived Effectiveness of Health Information Searching
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Online health has developed rapidly in recent years. Patients can find enormous information about most diseases on the Internet, and in the meantime search engines has become a necessary tool for online health information seeking. However, there are also many obstacles for users to find the most satisfied information through search engines, for example information overload, the anonymity of network, the cheating of the search engine algorithm used by amoral websites, the rank auction of advertisement in search engines. The paper designed a theory model “the relationship between the providence of warning information and advices (process of users' empowerment) and the results of users' empowerment outcome”. through modifying the users' empowerment theory. This paper designed an experimental study, involving two different warning information contents (with detailed explanation and limited explanation) and two styles of warning information appearance (high visibility and low visibility) based on the prior literature and the focus group interviews. The findings showed visibility and explanation has significant main effect on perceived usefulness and perceived effectiveness of warning message. And there is significant interaction effect of visibility and explanation on perceived usefulness of warning message. However, the interaction of visibility and explanation on perceived effectiveness of warning message is not significant.

articleTitle: Research on an evaluation model of social impact bonds to reduce the short-term achievements tendency
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Social Impact Bonds (SIBs) is a new way of public service financing in the world. In this structure, Government, private investors, and social enterprise cooperate together to solve social problems. The main service provider of SIBs is a social enterprise. This paper analyzes the influence of SIBs on social enterprises. Due to imperfect evaluation system, outcome-based SIBs project tends to focus on short term results. It causes the social enterprise to solve social problems unfairly and partially. Therefore, we need to reconstruct the evaluation model of SIBs. In this study, the evaluation model based on the SIB solving homeless problems in the UK is constructed by the weight function. The new model can reduce the restriction of short-term outcome tendency on social enterprise, and ensure the fairness of social enterprise.

articleTitle: Green Routing Optimization for Logistics Distribution with Path Flexibility and Service Time Window
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In the process of logistics distribution, the transportation system is usually disturbed by complex factors, which leads to the dynamic and randomness of the vehicle speed. Meanwhile, there are lots of alternative paths between any two customers in the actual urban distribution network. This paper will investigate the routing optimization in logistics enterprises under time-dependent transportation environment, which is of great significance to realize green low-carbon distribution. Firstly, the method of solving the optimal path between customers is given on the basis of dealing with the dynamic of vehicle speed. Secondly, for the purpose of minimizing carbon emissions and total travel time, the green distribution routing optimization model considering the customer service time window is formulated. Thirdly, a case study is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Entity Retail Platform Competition with the Difference in Consumer Preference on Brand
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Separating the consumers into two groups, namely, brand-loving and brand-neutral, the paper builds the price and commodity supply model to study the effects of consumers' attitude to brand and the coverage of consumer market on the entity retail platform. The results show an increase in the proportion of brand-loving consumers increases the rate of commission formulated by platform and the entity retail platform's profits whatever the consumer market is covered or partially-covered; the effects of the brand-loving on the entity retail platform's added value depend on whether the consumer market is wholly covered or partially covered.

articleTitle: Research on Retailer's Ordering Decision Under Credit Rating with Stochastic Demand Influenced by Sales Effort
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In practice, it's common that a upstream supplier can offer various discounts to her high credit rating downstream retailers, such as wholesale price discount, quantity discount, trade credit and so on. This paper considers a two level supply chain with a supplier and a retailer; the optimal ordering decisions of the retailer are studied under different credit rating status facing stochastic demand. Differ from the traditional literatures, we assume in this paper that the retailer can have the opportunity to influence his credit rating level by the sales effort on his customers, that is, the higher order quantity could induce his supplier to raise his credit up to the so called vip customer and may not otherwise. We show the structure of the optimal policies and discuss the relationship between the optimal ordering and the sales effort. We show that the retailer's profit increases by the initial working capital level. And the retailer's ordering policy is decided not only by his initial capital level, but also by the sales profit cost. In numerical study, we find the retailer will either choose to be normal customer or to be vip customer in different situations.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Present Situation of Public Entrepreneurship Service Management
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In order to promote the implementation of “Mass Entrepreneurship”, this paper adopts the data of 2015 National floating population dynamic Monitoring Survey (Volume B) to carry out the research to show the present situation of service management of mass entrepreneurship. The subject of this research includes the entrepreneur's employment status and situation and the basic public health guarantee of entrepreneur. And then make some discussions on the publicity of entrepreneurship (especially targeting women and high education professionals), continuing education, the development of other regions, the implementation of the safeguards system and the health knowledge education etc, to promote public entrepreneurship service level.

articleTitle: New Results on Multitasking via Alternate Period Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper is motivated by disruptions that occur when jobs are processed by human instead of machine. For mitigating the loss of productivity, we study a single machine scheduling problem with alternate periods including odd period and even-period. In this problem, we consider continuous processing, which means preemption is not allowed. Two objectives are considered: makespan (1|alt|C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub>) and tardiness time (1|alt|T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub>). We devise a dynamic programming algorithm and analyze the complexity of problem. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to use dynamic programming to minimize C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub> and T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub> without preemptions under alternate period.

articleTitle: Managing Procurement Through Option Contracts for a Firm Under Supply Disruption Risk
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Supply disruption is a common phenomenon in practice. In this study, we investigate the firm's optimal procurement strategy through two kinds of option contracts under supply disruption risk. Through theoretical analysis and numerical simulation, we obtain some important managerial implications. Under AOPC, the unreliable supplier is always utilized due to the economic advantage. When the option price is low, the firm will always reserve options from the reliable supplier. With the increase of the disruption risk, the firm will rely more on the reliable supplier to mitigate supply risk. Under COPC, when the option price and disruption information cost is relatively large, the order strategy in this scenario can be represented by two single-sourcing optimal order points. Otherwise, the firm will decrease the normal order and rely more on the contingency option reservation. When the disruption information cost is relatively low, it is beneficial for the firm to obtain more disruption information and postpone her option reservation decision in most situations. When the disruption information cost is moderate, the firm will choose AOPC and COPC alternately, as the disruption risk increases.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Information Transparency, Investor Sentiment and IPO Underpricing
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: IPO underpricing is a long-term vision in the stock market. In the process of using the sentiment of investors to explain the underpricing of IPO, the paper considers the factors of information transparency. Through the empirical study of the IPO of Shenzhen Stock Exchange from 2010 to 2012, the paper found that the higher the transparency of information, the more significant impact that investor sentiment on IPO underpricing.

articleTitle: A Framework of Petroleum Information Retrieval System Based on Web Scraping with Python
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: It is very necessary to build a customized retrieval system in the era of the big information explosion. This paper gives a framework of petroleum information retrieval system which will be used by petroleum exploration and development researchers. First, we use the open source framework SCRAPY to build a crawler system to crawl the information that business people pay attention to. Then k-means algorithm is used to cluster the crawled documents, therefore the key information is extracted and presented in the system. The actual effect in production and operation shows that this customized retrieval system is efficient and agile, it improves the efficiency, accuracy and automation level of the work.

articleTitle: Study on Technology Roadmap of Plant Extract Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper applies the basic principles and methods of industry technology roadmap to analyze the market demand, industry target, technology barrier, research and development demand of plant extract industry in China. Based on the results, a comprehensive technology roadmap of plant extract industry in China is drawn. Finally, according to the roadmap, the paper puts forward the following suggestions: improve existing quality standard system according to international standards, enhance core competitiveness of enterprises and cultivate leading enterprises, increase input in basic research and promote industry upgrading, improve administrative management regulations aimed at plant extract.

articleTitle: The Impact of Medical Services and Medicine Separation Policy on Competitive Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Performance
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper takes the performance of pharmaceutical supply chain as the research object, and combines with the medical reform policy to investigates the existing problems of the reform policy. This paper constructs a function model for pharmaceutical companies, hospitals and patients from the perspective of supply chain, and analyzes the decision selection and equilibrium profit of them under different policies. We found that under certain conditions, increasing service prices can increase both patient utility and hospital profit. In the process of medical reform, proper service price can improve the performance of the pharmaceutical supply chain.

articleTitle: Analysis of Supplier's Market Entry Decision with Traffic Congestion Cost
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In recent years, it is increasingly common for suppliers to open a direct channel and sell products directly to consumers. While direct channel management has been studied thoroughly in the literature, the effect of traffic congestion is often ignored. This paper considers consumer's sensitivity to traffic congestion as a key variable and sets up a model to investigate supplier's decision on whether to open a direct channel to enter the downstream market. We show that the supplier is better off by opening a direct channel if consumers are not very sensitive to traffic congestion, but traffic congestion indeed reduces the supplier's incentive of opening a direct channel. We also analyze how the demands and profits of the supplier and retailer change with consumers' sensitivity to traffic congestion.

articleTitle: Pricing and Coordination in a Closed-Loop Supply Chain with TOR and TON Programs Under Distribution and Direct Channels
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Based on the different receptivity of new and remanufactured products, considering the coexistence of “trade old for new” (TON) and “trade old for remanufactured” (TOR) programs, we develop a game model of closed-loop supply chain (CLSC) under distribution channel and direct channel. First, the conditions of TON and TOR programs are discussed under centralized decisions. Then, the optimal pricing decisions between distribution and direct channels are compared under decentralized scenarios. The results show the remanufacturing cost savings is closely related to TON and TOR programs; under the distribution channel, the price of new and remanufactured products is higher than the direct situation; under the direct channel, TOR program can promote the recycling of waste products, and the profits of the manufacturer and CLSC will be improved, while the retailer's profit will be reduced. In view of the efficiency loss of decentralized decisions, the perfect coordination of CLSC can be realized by using revenue sharing contract under distribution channel; while, to the direct channel, a profit sharing contract can coordinate the CLSC. Finally, combined with the numerical analysis to verify the above conclusions, and further analyzes the impacts of remanufactured products receptivity, products durability, residual value of waste products and remanufacturing cost savings on the profits of the manufacturer, the retailer and CLSC under different channels.

articleTitle: A Literature Review on Financial Fraud
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Financial fraud has attracted the attentions of researchers because it concerns with many different market participants. The fraudulent firms provide misleading information in the financial reports in order to achieve unethical goals. Investors can suffer losses if they use such information to make decisions. Therefore, it is important to detect fraud in financial statements. This paper includes two parts: Part I talks about the motivations and influences of financial frauds. Part II talks about how to detect financial fraud in the financial statements.

articleTitle: The Relationship Between Economic Growth and Industrial Structure in Middle-Income Countries
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Based on Chenery's theoretical hypothesis and Cobb Douglas production function, the article uses PVAR model to analyze the relationship between economic growth and industrial structure in 32 middle-income countries during 1980 to 2014. According to the testing results, there is a long-term and stable relationship between economic growth and industrial structure in middle-income countries. As for each country, Granger causality test shows that the relationship between economic growth and three industries vary from country to country, even though they have the same effect in general. In addition, with the development of the third scientific and technological revolution, the tertiary industry has a significant development in upper-income countries, while the middle-income country and lower income countries still greatly depend on the secondary industry.

articleTitle: Decision Analysis of Government and Manufacturer Under Green Loan Policy
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the optimal solutions in the Stackelberg game with government and a monopolistic manufacturer with green production under the green loan policy. The government will offer the interest subsidy depending on the environmental effort coefficient of the green products. The manufacturer will always take high pricing strategy to maximize its profit and make its pricing decision based on the subsidy offered by the government. By comparing with the optimal results in the case of no green loan policy, the manufacturer's profit, consumer surplus and environmental influence after the implementation of green loan policy are all improved, and there exists Pareto improvement. This paper also gives some suggestion to the policy maker.

articleTitle: Dose the Use of Big Data Analytics Guarantee a High Firm Performance? An Empirical Study Bases on the Dynamic Capabilities Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: For the sake of enriching relevant research field, this study focuses on two main questions: (1) What is the effect of DBA usage on firm performance (including market performance and operational performance)? and (2) What factors that drive organizations to use big data analytics (BDA) are key drivers, based on dynamic capabilities theory? And we also identified the moderating effect of environmental dynamism between BDA use and firm performance. Furthermore, we introduce the need pull/technology push framework to identify and theorize paths via which factors influence the use of BDA. Purely from the need pull/technology push theory perspective, we propose that perceived usefulness of BDA should belong to need pull factor. Thus, we select perceived usefulness and satisfaction level with existing IT technology as need pull factors, BDA use of competitors and technology compatibility as technology push factors for big data analytics (BDA) use, and examines if these factors have a positive effect on big data analytics (BDA).

articleTitle: To Identify Technology Frontier for Mass-Customized Production Service Converged with Artificial Intelligence Based on Patent Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This research aims to study the technology frontier of mass-customized (MC) production service based on technology development trajectory analysis. MC production service has been put forward for about 50 years, and the development of artificial intelligence (AI) raises the intriguing possibility of using MC production mode to satisfy the more and more diverse needs of customers. In this research, the author utilizes both expert interviews and patent analysis to explore the technology development trajectory of information technology and customized production technology to realize MC production, and to identify the technology frontier. The paper purposes a method based on patent analysis integrated the expert opinions to identify the technology frontier. Based on the analysis, the technology related with customized production has been divided into five parts - production process algorithm, production scheduling technology, product storage and transportation technology, customers' demands analysis technology, and system optimization technology. Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and social network analysis based on patent data are utilized to the fusion development trajectory of information technology and the five parts of customized production technology, respectively. As the results, Derwent Innovation database is utilized to obtain the patent data and the citation network data, and the analysis indicates that AI technology provides more opportunities on the development of MC production service. The fusion of AI technology and customers' demands analysis, and the fusion of AI technology and system optimization are more likely to be achieved, while the fusion of AI technology and production scheduling technology and product storage and transportation technology are still to be developed, one of which is the core process of manufacturing - production scheduling. Finally, this research suggests to support the development of MC production service converged with AI technology, especially on the development of production scheduling technology.

articleTitle: Route-like Demand Location Problem Under Competitive Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: In this paper, we research on a location problem when the demand is continuous in a route under competitive environment. Route-like demand is satisfied by two competitive logistics points and the distribution depends on their different utility. We use linear integral instead of discrete points to describe the demand. Considering the feature of route-like demand and the competitive location problem, we innovate the existing research from many aspects such as demand function, distance function etc, and form a objective function of profit. Through the design of small-scale calculation examples and the application of genetic algorithm to solve the problem, finally obtain locations and scales for newly built target in a reasonable range, as well as related profits and costs. Furthermore, we based on the changes in utility parameters to analyze its effect on the target value.

articleTitle: Temporal Item Embedding with Static Similarity Regularization for Sequential Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Recommender systems have attracted a significant amount of research interests in recent years. Traditional methods such as content-based approaches and collaborative filtering approaches mainly focus on modeling the general user preference by using the user's whole purchase history. However, except for user preference, the sequential information should also be considered because human behavior exhibits sequential patterns. The methods considering both sequential item relationship and user preference are called sequential recommendation methods, which are mostly base on Markov Chains. Due to the difficulty of parameter estimation, most prior work only considers the latest interaction, which is insufficient according to our observations. To that end, in this paper, we propose a temporal item embedding method based on word2vec framework to model long purchase history, with each purchased item regarded as a word in sentence. Meanwhile, inspired by the collaborative filtering in traditional recommendations, we assume that similar items should have similar embeddings and propose static similarity regularization (SSR) in recommendation. The regularized item embedding can capture user preference and sequential item relationship simultaneously. Experiments on real-world datasets show that the proposed approach outperforms a spectrum of state-of-the-art algorithms.

articleTitle: Decentralized Procurement of Durable Goods with Strategic Inventories
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Industry practitioners and academic researches typically view decentralized procurement as an underperforming choice. In this paper, we counter-intuitively demonstrate that decentralization can actually benefit a firm when it with multiple divisions procures durable goods from a supplier in terms of its strategic use of inventories. We study a two-period model and identify the equilibrium results on the supplier's wholesale prices, the firm's order quantities and inventory levels, and profits under centralized and decentralized procurements. The analytic results show that the firm's profit can be improved through each division's decision on the durable good procurement. In particular, decentralized procurement can provide a moderate inventory levels and thus alleviate the time-inconsistent issues of durable good procurement. Moreover, we show that the profit improvement always increase in durability and the number of divisions.

articleTitle: Location of a Conservative Hyperplane for Disjoint Bilinear Programming Based on Distances
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The generation of a conservative cut is an effective approach for degeneracy removal in cutting plane methods for disjoint bilinear programming (DBLP), but the location of such a hyperplane seems time-consuming. This paper presents several revised distance-following algorithms within one framework in order to identify a conservative hyperplane. We demonstrate their computational efficiency from both the degree of degeneracy and the dimensionality. Numerical results are reported.

articleTitle: Disease Patterns Recognition Based on User-Generated Content
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the prosperous development of medical communities such as DingXiang, Good-Doctor-Online, how to use user-generated content (UGC) to tap the hidden value, and better serve the doctors and patients have become a common concern. In this paper, the DingXiang UGC was employed to extract symptom words. The association rules mining based on the skewed support distribution was used to disclose the frequent patterns between the symptoms and diseases. At the same time, the robustness was measured and evaluated. The results of this study can not only help patients with initial self-diagnosis, but also shed light on new ideas for medical research from a data-driven manner.

articleTitle: A Maximal Covering Location Model of Ambulances in Emergency Medical Service
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Emergency medical service (EMS), known as one of the most important health care services, plays a vital part in saving people's lives. Among the EMS problems, deployment of ambulances is a hot issue. A lot of research has done from different aspects to find a better plan on ambulance deployment. This paper is going to solve the maximal covering location problem using an improved Double Standard Model, considering the probability that an ambulance is not available all the time. The model is applied to the data from Songjiang District, Shanghai, and we obtain deployment schemes under different probability. The demand covered by at least two working ambulances increases by using our solution.

articleTitle: A Study of Acceptance of Weibo Forwarding Advertising Based on Motivation Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the ever-increasing influence of social media such as Weibo, social media advertising has gradually received attention. In recent years, compared with traditional advertising, social media advertising has developed more rapidly and has a better prospect. Therefore, whether it is from the perspective of advertisers or from the perspective of consumers, it is of great significance to explore the factors that affect advertising acceptance. On the basis of reviewing a large number of related research, we proposes a research model that mainly studies the relationship between motivation and the advertising acceptance of Weibo forwarding advertising, and discusses the moderating effect of involvement. Data will be collected from undergraduates and postgraduates at a certain university in the south. This research can provide suggestions for advertisers to improve their advertising, so as to achieve a win-win situation between advertisers and consumers. Implications and suggestions for future research are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Virtual Reality in Remote Education Based on the Example of MOOC
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: MOOC is one of the most popular remote education systems in the world, but it has a technical platform in the field of operation in experiment and interaction among students. Because VR has outstanding technical characteristics in image simulation and interactive application, this paper thinks that VR can be applied to the service system of remote education.From the perspective of service management and technology application, this paper mainly discusses the function orientation of VR in remote education service and its education mode. After the research, this paper finally built a service model of VR remote education system, and also put forward the software, hardware and system development platform needed to build the system.

articleTitle: Does Omnichannel Selling with Pre-Order and Returns Benefit Consumers?
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Firms begin to shift from multichannel to omnichan-nel. In this paper, we study the omnichannel selling with pre-orders and return policy from different consumers' perspective. We find that omnichannel selling can satisfy more consumers with demand updating. And this new selling strategy brings about a higher consumer welfare in most cases. We identify the thresholds for price discount, returns refund and demand uncertainty, above which omnichannel benefits consumers. In addition, in terms of return policy, omnichannel with returns policy brings about higher consumer welfare than that without returns in most cases unless the returns refund is relatively high and the demand uncertainty is not significant. More managerial insights are developed with numerical analysis.

articleTitle: A Study on the Impact of Financial Development on the RMB Settlement of Cross-Border Trade
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the continuous progress of China's financial reform, financial development has been deepened, providing a good environmental basis for the internationalization of the RMB. According to the theory of currency choice in international settlement, financial development is one of the important factors affecting the choice of international currency. This article will focus on the financial perspective, pointing out the way that financial development aff ects RMB settlement of cross-border trade, and VEC empirical model is used to verify the promoting effect of financial development on RMB settlement of cross-border trade.

articleTitle: Online Retailing Promotion Strategy Under Platform Scheme with Considering Seller Competition
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper studies the online retailing promotion strategy in presence of seller competition. We consider two competing sellers who both sell substitutable products on an online retailing platform under a revenue sharing contract. The sellers simultaneously decide whether to join the promotion or not first and then the seller who chooses to join will decide his (her) own promotion rebate after the platform leads the promotion program. This paper characterizes the sellers' and the platform's optimal strategies and profits among different competition scenarios with Nash Game and Stackelberg Game Model. In the numerical study, we can directly infer that the two sellers will be caught in a Prisoner's Dilemma where they may conduct fierce price competition when the platform 's commission rate is rather small. At this time, the platform will earn more without offering any platform rebate among other promotion scenarios.

articleTitle: Attention-Based Bi-LSTM Model for Anomalous HTTP Traffic Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Recently, cyber-attacks with complex types have occurred more frequently than before, while communication traffic provides a clue to probe anomalous network behaviors. Therefore, how to detect malicious network attacks from large scale communication traffic in a timely manner and grasp their attack characteristics is a major challenge for website security. Since the content of the network traffic complies with strict writing specifications and structural standards, it is usually modeled and analyzed as natural language. In this paper, we propose a deep neural network model utilizing Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) with attention mechanism to model HTTP traffic as a natural language sequence. The application of attention mechanism can assist in detecting anomalous traffic and discovering critical parts of anomalous traffic. Extensive experiments over large traffic data have illustrated that the proposed model has outstanding performance in malicious HTTP traffic detection.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Reservation Service for Smart Parking System
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: To deal with parking problems in big cities, smart parking systems are launched by public or private organizations. This study proposes a real-time parking reservation service to minimize the total travel cost of all users. A mixed-integer programming model is formulated to allocate slots and schedule drivers' travel plans efficiently. The allocation and scheduling model can improve the parking experiences of drivers and increase the utilization of parking slots, compared with traditional parking reservation services without scheduling module. We then establish an experiment setting to simulate the parking demand from different types of drivers (commuters and visitors) in a central business district. We investigate supplying policies of parking slots to satisfy the parking demand during a whole day with considering different performance metrics. The experiment results give insights and guidelines for practical parking management organizations.

articleTitle: Personality Recognition Based on User Generated Content
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Personality recognition has lots of applications, like business recommendation systems, human resource management, author identification and psychological treatment. Traditionally, identifying one's personality traits depends on questionnaire scales. With the development of the Internet, people can express their opinions, emotions, attitudes, etc., on social networks. From the viewpoint of psychology, people's behaviors and decisions are influenced by their personality characteristics, so it's convenient for us to recognize one's personality based on his social network content. In this paper, we build a new personality recognition model based on a standard dataset, i.e., the Facebook update status content. Firstly, we extract the language features via the Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count (LIWC) dictionary tool. Then all the words in the status content are trained by Google news pre-trained word2vec embedding with 300 dimensions. Next, we construct the personality recognition model by using the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) method with the LIWC features. We conduct five binary classifications on the most widely used personality model, i.e., the big five personality that contains five traits: extroversion, neuroticism, agreeableness, conscientiousness, and openness. Finally, our experimental results demonstrate that the method we present in this paper achieves very good performances, especially on the openness trait.

articleTitle: Stock Market Embedding and Prediction: A Deep Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: It has always been a challenging issue for people to understand the stock market and make reasonable predictions. For a very long period, investors are trying to manually extract useful features from the financial market which generates an enormous volume of data every single day. People create a lot of technical indicators like MACD, TR, MFI to describe momentum, volume and volatility signals of the financial time series. However, the limitation is evident due to the efficiency of manually feature engineering. With the rapidly growing volume of data, deep neural network shows excellent performance in many research areas like natural language processing, voice recognition, image identification. It provides a new view to dig out potentially useful information automatically. In this paper, we present a novel end-to-end training using an embedding method to automatically extract features and get a summary representation of the daily market. Moreover, we apply the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) with attention mechanism to predict daily return ratio of HS300 index. The features extracted by the embedding layer show greater predictive power than manually defined technical signals by 92.42% lower MSE. Moreover, the use of attention mechanism also provides an average enhance of 55.68% in MSE. Our study shows that deep neuron network structure has a strong potential for better understanding market complex behaviors.

articleTitle: The Key Factors of Successful Internet Crowdfunding Projects - An Empirical Study Based on Different Platforms
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Crowdfunding, as a new conception in fundraising, provides access to get fund in the background of Internet. This paper has conducted a research on the key factors to highly successful crowdfunding based on two biggest crowdfunding platforms in China - JingDong crowdfunding platform and TaoBao crowdfunding platform. By using Logistic regression model, we find that different platform designs and different mechanisms have effect on the project success. Meanwhile, quality signals that the founders show and their own experience do have a positive association with high success of projects. Other factors that are visible directly on crowdfunding website are also been discussed.

articleTitle: Research on the Classification of Urban Rail Transit Stations - Taking Shanghai Metro as an Example
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: At present, the average daily passenger flow are more than tens of millions in workday in Shanghai rail transit. It is normal for office workers to experience the peak of morning and evening crowded. It also causes great difficulties for managers to operate. In order to optimize the operation of the subway services, improve the quality of the management of the subway, clustering analysis and classification management of the subway sites are done. This paper takes Shanghai subway as the research object, using the data for September 2016 from intelligent traffic card of Shanghai Subway, select the site features and the related 36 factors as the initial variables of cluster analysis, extract 5 main factors from the variables to reduce the variable dimensions, and the extracted main factors is used to cluster the sites and divide the Shanghai subway Line 359 subway stations into several sites types with different congestion degree by the K-means clustering method. Selecting site with high congestion degree as object of study, some suggestions of optimizing improvement are put forward.

articleTitle: Green Construction Supply Chain Performance Evaluation Based on BSC-SCOR
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the sustainable development has become the theme of social activities, the construction industry is facing the resources and environmental pressure caused by high energy consumption and high pollution. Green construction supply chain management has become the inevitable trend of the development of the construction industry. In order to improve the scientific rationality and operability of green construction supply chain performance evaluation, this paper analyzes the characteristics of green construction supply chain. Based on the Balanced Scorecard (BSC) model and Supply-Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) model, this paper constructs a green building performance evaluation index system. Due to the uncertainty and complexity of evaluation, considering the subjective and objective factors, the G1 method and entropy method were used to determine the comprehensive weight of the indicators, and introduce the grey correlation theory to establish the comprehensive evaluation model of green construction supply chain. The model and algorithm were applied to the case study, and more accurate and objective evaluation results were obtained. It provides a useful perspective for the green supply chain performance evaluation and continuous improvement in the construction industry with important theoretical and practical application value.

articleTitle: Telecomm Fraud Detection via Attributed Bipartite Network
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Internet malicious incident occur frequently in recent years, bringing huge loss in different fields such as telecommunication, finance, etc. Such incidents generally entail fraudulent behaviors, which deviate from normal behavioral patterns. Particularly, in telecommunication, those anomalous interactions can be manifested by the network formed through interactions between callers and callees. Telecommunication network is indeed a bipartite, directed, and attributed network, and the anomalous network structure can be better captured by simultaneously considering these distinctive perspectives. To that end, in this paper, we propose a novel metric to measure the abnormality of dense subgraph structure by considering the structure, temporal changes, as well the attributes on nodes and edges. We further formulate an objective function and propose a greedy approach to discover the structure and corresponding fraudsters. The proposed metric and algorithm are experimented on a real-world telecommunication network dataset, which is shown to achieve competitive fraud detection performance than the baseline methods.

articleTitle: Study on Omnichannel Service for Time-Sensitive and Price-Sensitive Demand
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: More and more restaurants carry out omni-channel operation through online self-service and take-out service. Online self-order service refers to consumer make orders through `Meituan', `Elemo' APP in the mobile phone or smart device by themselves and retailer takes the responsibility for preparing and distributing food (take-out service), which means that consumers can enjoy the food without in store. In this paper, we combine the basic model of queueing theory and retailer's profit function to study the impact of omni-channel service on customers' demand, customers' waiting time, restaurant's service capacity and profits. When the price is close to the operation cost, the main conclusions of this research are as following: 1). The implementation of online self-service reduce the waiting time and increase the consumer demand for online and offline; 2). A certain degree of takeaway delivery fee will increase the frequency of consumer's consumption; 3). omni-channel improve the profits of restaurant.

articleTitle: Explore the Effects of Opinion Leader's Characteristics and Information on Consumer's Purchase Intention: Weibo Case
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the development of the technology and social media, the micro-blog began to enter people's lives. We have a new information environment and more competitive market. Weibo opinion leaders become a hot issue for e-commerce industry and academics. In this paper, we want to explore the effects of micro-blog opinion leaders on consumer's purchase intention. This study uses a modified TRA model and constructs an online questionnaire for data collection. Then, structural equation model is adopted for fitting and path analysis. We found that: In all 16 hypotheses, 9 of them have significant positive correlation, which verified that variants including professional knowledge, product involvement, interaction and consistency influence trust. And at the same time, professional knowledge, product involvement and visual cue impact perceived value directly. The results of this study provide principles for the enterprises to operate the micro-blog marketing.

articleTitle: A Two-stage Stochastic Programming Approach for Aircraft Landing Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: This paper considers a two-stage stochastic programming problem for airport runway scheduling under the uncertainty of arrival time on a single runway. The goal of airport runway scheduling is to schedule a set of aircrafts in a given time horizon and minimize a corresponding objective while satisfying separation requirements as well as other practical constraints. In order to boost runway elasticity and throughout, a mess of unpredictable factors, such as weather, pilot behavior and airport surface traffic, should be take into consideration by airport regulator. The arrival scheduling problem at airport can be decomposed into sequential decision problem, where the first stage determines the sequence of aircraft weight class, while the individual flight is assigned to positions in the weight class sequence in the second stage. The main mission of this work is to identify an optimal schedule involving the arrival time of flight is stochastic under different scenarios. A stochastic aircraft landing problem (SALP) formulation based on time-dependent traveling salesman problem (TDTSP) is proposed. Then a sample average approximation (SAA) algorithm is developed to solve this stochastic programming and the efficacy is verified by experimental result.

articleTitle: Exploring Digital Transformation and Digital Culture in Service Organizations
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Digital transformation changes the way how companies and individuals operate and interact with their surrounding environment. New digital channels provide service companies both opportunities and threaths. One of the valuable opportunities is to affect positively customers' service experiences. Digital Experience (DX) can be defined as meeting and exceeding changing customer expectations via digital channels, platforms and touchpoints. In this paper, we focus on exploring digital transformation and digital culture in the context of service management. The research problem of this study is: How digital transformation and digital culture are visible in service provider organizations? The main contribution of this paper is to provide findings on challenges in digitalization, digitalization patterns that exist in daily service management work and actions service employees are performing to develop and contribute to the digital culture. Multiple sources of evidence from TUPLA project industry partners and narratives on digitalization were used in data collection.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Cluster Analysis of E-Businesses with Perishable Products and Cold Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The number of e-business companies with perishable products and cold chain logistics in China has increased year by year, but there have been few comprehensive evaluations of e-business companies with perishable products. This article selects 18 e-business companies with fresh and perishable products that are still in operation as samples, and establishes 12 evaluation indexes through data capture of customer online comments, text mining, and questionnaire survey. SPSS 22.0 software is used to conduct factor and cluster analysis. The measures that are used to evaluate these companies are analyzed through factor analysis. After the factor analysis, the status and ranking of the comprehensive power status of these companies were obtained. The data is also subjected to cluster analysis and these companies are classified as three groups and they can be managed differently based on their respective groups. Through the radar diagram, we found out that the most influential factors that consumers are concerned about EBPCs are freshness, fresh quality, and logistics distribution efficiency.

articleTitle: What Drives the Use of M-Payment? An Empirical Study About Alipay and WeChat Payment
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the development of e-commerce and technology, a new payment method, mobile payment, is widely used. The purpose of this study is to investigate the factors affecting consumers' adoption of mobile payment. To increase the explanatory power of the model, we propose an extend technology acceptance model (TAM) containing more factors. Specially, we divide perceived risk into two main kinds, perceived financial risk and perceived information risk, to study the different mechanism. To test our model, we conducted an online survey and received 295 valid questionnaires. The result shows that perceived ease of use and perceived trust have a positive and significant impact on consumers' intention to use mobile payment. Further, we find perceived compatibility have a positive and significant impact on perceived ease of use. Beyond our expectation, perceived information risk has a positive impact on both use intention and perceived usefulness.

articleTitle: Hybrid Recommendation Algorithm Based on Hamming Clustering for User's Access Log and Weighted User Behavior
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: When the Hamming clustering is applied to personalized recommendations for the user access logs, since it does not reflect the user's preference for the project, so we proposed a hybrid recommendation algorithm based on Hamming clustering and weighted user behavior. This algorithm improves Hamming clustering in two aspects-sparse matrix processing and also improves the number of hits on the Web page, thus preventing the accidental clicks from affecting the user's clustering result. And we used the log-likelihood ratio to calculate the similarity of the users, and then filter the recommendation content through the weighted user behavior model. This model includes three aspects: the similarity between the users, the weighted user behavior and the visit time for the users. According to the data from the Github Archive website, it indicates that the proposed algorithm has a higher recommendation in terms of quality and efficiency.

articleTitle: The Stochastic Home Health Care Routing Problem in Dense Communities with Multi-Appointment
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The Stochastic Home Health Care Scheduling and Routing Problem refers to a decision process that allocates a group of nurses to a group of elders, with considerations of both stochastic and deterministic constraints. This paper studies the SHHCSRP in dense communities, where traveling distance is shortened and waiting cost is possibly higher. Other constraints considered in this paper include multi-appointment, mixed time window and skill-demand matching. A chance constrained programming model is built to formulate the problem, and a heuristic based on the Best-Worst Ant Colony Optimization is developed to solve it. A medium scale instance is experimented, and it turns out that, 1) sequences of nurses have a significant impact on the solution, 2) waiting limitation should be well-adjusted to balance the waiting time and total workload.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis and Optimization for Supply Chain Finance Business Process Based on Petri Nets
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Efficient business process is very important for enterprises to obtain funds from supply chain finance(SCF). Currently many deficiencies exist in the process of SCF such as complex flows and time-consuming period. It is necessary to analyze and optimize SCF business processes. This study empirically investigates, establishes and analyzes the supply chain financing business processes based on Petri nets model. We find out the key process and recombine the model structure. Compared with the original Petri nets, the optimized Petri net model can reduce the place busy probability, control the critical events' risks, shorten the processes time, and eventually improve the efficiency of the supply chain finance business process. This study can provide valuable insights and useful suggestions for related organizers to establish the more scientific and efficient supply chain financial business processes.

articleTitle: Matching Recommendations Based on Siamese Network and Metric Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Clothing matching is always making customers in trouble because it is both time-consuming and challenging. To solve the issue of “What outfit matches this piece of shirt?”, recommendation tasks have attracted attentions from scholars. Most existing recommendation systems focus on the similarity between items or user's interest in items. A few studies pay attention to matching recommendations which are based on the visual features of items. Identifying and understanding relationships between items is the base of the matching recommendation tasks. A distance between items can be defined to measure the relationships. Therefore, we explore a novel recommendation framework to integrate visual features with category features based on Siamese architecture and metric learning. The distance between items can be learnt in target space (matching space) rather than in the input space (original space). In the matching space, the matching items are close to each other while the mismatching items are far away. Compared with the baselines, our methods show great superiority which demonstrates that the matching space defined in our framework is more suitable for learning the matching relationship between items. The results also show that training in both visual features and category features performs better than that of training in only one of them. The method can be even better if giving more negative samples for an item.

articleTitle: How Does Relationship Marketing Influence Purchase Intention in Fine Arts Sector in Mongolia?
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The purpose of the present study is to examine the impacts of the purchasing characteristics on consumer relationship building process with the presence of perceived trust and perceived satisfaction as the mediators. This study employs a structural equation modeling (SEM) approach to explain how and to what extent each variable affects purchase intention. SPSS and Analysis of Moment Structures (AMOS) statistical software are used for data analysis. A total of 303 respondents of art institutions of Mongolia were surveyed with a questionnaire tool. The results show that perceived relationship investment, customer satisfaction, and trust significantly influenced customers' purchase intention. The interactions among these constructs reveal important implications for art marketers planning relationship building strategies.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Pasteurized Milk Cold Chain Logistics Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the popularity of pasteurized milk.the requirements for quality and quantity from customers are increasing. This article takes cold chain distribution network of the Guangzhou dairy company as research object and bases on the special needs of pasteurized milk on time and temperature.establishing a vehicle routing optimization model of cold chain logistics with time window in dynamic network model through improving traditional vehicle routing problem. Also, a hybrid genetic algorithm is designed to solve the model which uses the excellent local search ability of hill climbing algorithm to optimize the genetic algorithm. Finally, it analyzes data from the company sets reasonable parameters and obtains the optimization results through which, the author gives corresponding recommendations in order to improve the quality of dairy products and the cold chain delivery efficiency of this company.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Intention to Use Online Medical Service
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and the increase of people's health awareness, online medical service dedicated to provide efficient and convenient health services emerging increasingly. Previous literatures had focused on a single form of online medical service. In practice, studying the various factors influencing the use of such service is necessary. This paper integrates the technology acceptance model(TAM) and the theory of planned behavior(TPB) to understand the intention to use online medical service from a technical and behavioral perspective. Considering the potential risks of online medical services, the perceived risk is integrated to the research framework. The structural equation model is used to analyze the data of 259 users. The findings reveal that perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use and perceived risk are important factors affecting the attitude to use online medical services. Perceived usefulness, attitude, subjective norms and perceived behavioral control have a positive impact on intention to use the services.

articleTitle: Exploring the Attractive Attributes of Exhibition Experience in Museum
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Education is the key activities of museums, together with keeping, research and presentation of museum objects. Museum experiencing is one of the important and effective ways in the learning process for informal education. In contrast to static displays with textual information, dynamic experiences are interactive and interesting, allowing visitors to be involved in their operation to obtain the information and concepts developments. To explore the different impact of museum exhibition designs and to discuss interactive design and visitor experience, the case of the national science and technology museum in Kaohsiung is used as the studied case. 125 subjects between 9-12 years old students were recruited for the evaluation experiment. The two-dimensional Kano model is also used to explore the different effects of experience attributes on visitor satisfaction with exhibition in museum. According to the results, the critical experience attributes for appealing visitors were identified. By applying the Kano quality classifications, these experience attributes of exhibition were classified into different quality categories, including attractive, one-dimensional, must-be and indifferent qualities. The attractive and important affective attributes can be determined to resolve the trade-offs dilemma in multiple-attribute decision making. These can provide useful insights for museum and designers to design attractive experience of exhibition for enhancing visitor satisfaction.

articleTitle: Impact of Fairness Concern on Retailer-Dominated Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: On the basis of a two-echelon supply chain model, this study researches the impact of fairness concern on a supply chain with a dominant retailer and two manufacturers. Through mathematical analysis and numerical study, this work examines the effects of fairness concern coefficient on pricing, profitability, and utility of the supply chain members. Results show that when only the dominant retailer has fairness concerns, the utility of that retailer increases, while the retailer's profit declines slightly, and the profits of manufacturers decrease with the fairness concern coefficient of the retailer. In the case only the manufacturers have fairness concerns, when the manufacturers has more fairness concerns, then the utility of the manufacturer with the cost advantage increases and that of the manufacturer in the disadvantaged position decreases. The retailer benefits substantially with the fairness concerns of the manufacturers. In the case each member of the supply chain has fairness concerns, if members have additional fairness concerns, the profit of the dominant retailer will slightly decrease, whereas utility will increase. However, the profit and utility of the cost-disadvantaged manufacturer may significantly be reduced.

articleTitle: Carbon Dioxide Emissions Efficiency Analysis on China's Coastal Areas: A Super-Efficiency SBM Model
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The threats posed by global climate change, which are mainly caused by the emissions of greenhouse gases. And improving carbon dioxide emissions efficiency has been recognized as the most effective way to reduce the greenhouse effect and achieve sustainable development. A scientific evaluation of carbon dioxide emissions performance in China could not only provide valuable information for reducing energy consumption and carbon emissions but also serve as a tool to estimate the effectiveness of relevant policy reforms. This paper adopts data envelopment analysis approach to evaluate the carbon dioxide emissions efficiency in China's coastal areas over the period of 2006–2014. Carbon dioxide is treated as undesirable output of energy consumptions. The proposed super-efficiency SBM model is used to estimate the carbon dioxide emissions efficiency with an annual cross-section of data. The results indicate the following in China's coastal areas: (1) Jilin province has the highest carbon dioxide emissions efficiency, while the efficiency in Hebei province is worst. (2) China's 10 coastal areas have similar trends in the variation of efficiency and in general the carbon dioxide emissions efficiency of China's 10 coastal areas slightly increased from 2006 to 2014. (3) The carbon dioxide emissions efficiency scores decrease when considering undesirable outputs except Fujian and Guangdong. This paper gives some policy recommendations on improving carbon dioxide emissions efficiency in China's 10 coastal areas.

articleTitle: Impact of Industrial Agglomeration on Environmental Pollution:Evidence from Yangtze River City Cluster in Jiangsu Province
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Using panel data derived from 8 cities along Yangtze river in China' s Jiangsu Province, the paper analyzes the impact of industrial agglomeration on environmental pollution on the basis of elaborating their influencing mechanism, applying threshold model and drawing lessons from developed countries to make targeted recommendations. Estimated results are as follows. First, industrial agglomeration exacerbates industrial pollution emissions overall, but the negative environmental effects were weakened following Jiangsu's entering into the new period of time. Second, FDI can significantly reduce industrial pollutant emission. Third, investment in pollution control does not fully play its role in improving environmental quality.

articleTitle: Health Service Decision Toolbox (HSDT): Delivering the Right Treatment to the Right Patient with Health Information Technology and Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The amount of data being digitally collected and stored by health information technology (health IT) is vast and expanding rapidly. How to convert this huge amount of resources into knowledge that can facilitate delivering the right intervention to the right patient, or how to bridge the gap between prevention research and practice, remain unclear. The objective of this study is to develop a Health Service Decision Toolbox (HSDT) that enables healthcare providers to integrate vast data sources collected by Health IT to improve confidence in decisions of whether or not to adopt an evidence-based intervention. HSDT can guide users through feeding massive health related data into several major input groups, such as healthcare providers, patient population, and intervention procedures. With the HSDT, we can successfully project specific impacts, because of additional tailoring to fit each organization/patient population's unique circumstances. When such tailoring combined with an interactive visualization environment, it would further increase decision makers' confidence. We illustrate the use of HSDT with a case study of delivering Transitional Care Model (TCM) to the most needed hospitals. TCM is a proven care management approach that is designed and tested by University of Pennsylvania via multiple NIH funded clinicaclinicall trials.

articleTitle: What do Indonesian Facebook Advertisers Want? The Impact of E-Service Quality on E-Loyalty
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate the relationship of e-service quality, perceived value, e-satisfaction, and e-Ioyalty in Facebook ads service. Quantitative research is conducted via an online survey and total sample of 220 Indonesian Facebook advertisers. Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) is used to evaluate cause-and-effect relationship between construct. Descriptive analysis and factor analysis are also conducted to verify validity and reliability of the data. The findings showed that e-service quality identified as the most influential variable toward perceived value. Furthermore, e-satisfaction strongly associated with e-Ioyalty. This study yields several practical directions for digital advertising agencies especially Facebook as the owner of Facebook ads service. From a managerial standpoint, Facebook company should pay more attention to advertisers perceived value and advertisers e-satisfaction. Because a good service quality could increase advertiser's perceived value and e-satisfaction which lead to enhance advertiser's e-Ioyalty. Hence, digital advertising agencies should emphasize on information system service quality and customer service quality.

articleTitle: Research on Credit Risk of Bank Credit Asset Securitization - An Empirical Analysis Based on KMV Model
publicationTitle: 2018 15th International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management (ICSSSM)
abstract: Under the background of the current global economy, the economic restructuring and the reform of the financial system are urgent. As the leaders in the financial system, the commercial banks are also faced with huge business performance pressure and strategic innovation problems. Because the credit asset securitization has many characteristics that use assets to distribute the systemic risk of banking industry and improve the capital adequacy ratio of commercial banks through asset circulation, the implementation of credit asset securitization is highly expected by the state. As the “main force” of asset securitization, credit asset securitization has been promoted by a series of good factors, such as the reform of the record keeping system and the policy guidance of the State Council, and the market activity is gradually promoted, the participants are diversified and the basic assets are diversified. How to better realize the prevention of this risk, and to better solve the problems existing in China's financial market, and become the foundation of the healthy development of China's economy. On the basis of these problems, the emphasis is made on the empirical analysis of China Merchants Bank's asset backed securities in the third period of 2014 and through the KMV model.
